meta.name: baoyu-danger-gemini-web
meta.description: Generates images and text via reverse-engineered Gemini Web API. Supports text generation, image generation from prompts, reference images for vision input, and multi-turn conversations. Use when other skills need image generation backend, or when user requests "generate image with Gemini", "Gemini text generation", or needs vision-capable AI generation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要通过Gemini生成图片或文字内容
copy.tagline_en: Generate images and text with Gemini
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate images or text via Gemini

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以通过逆向工程调用 Gemini Web API 来生成文字和图片。支持多轮对话，也能把参考图片作为视觉输入。
howto.when: 当你要求“用 Gemini 生成图片”或“Gemini 文字生成”，或者需要具备视觉能力的 AI 生成时触发。

say.text: 用 Gemini 生成一张猫的图片。
say.note: Claude 会调用 Gemini 生成图片并返回。

say.text: 用 Gemini 写一段关于太空的短文。
say.note: Claude 会调用 Gemini 生成文字回复。

say.text: 用 Gemini 描述这张参考图片。
say.note: Claude 会调用 Gemini 分析图片并描述。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate text and images via the reverse-engineered Gemini Web API. It supports multi-turn conversations and can use reference images for vision input.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "generate image with Gemini" or "Gemini text generation", or when you need vision-capable AI generation.

say_en.text: Generate an image of a cat using Gemini.
say_en.note: Claude will call Gemini to generate the image.

say_en.text: Write a short paragraph about space using Gemini.
say_en.note: Claude will call Gemini to generate text.

say_en.text: Describe this reference image using Gemini.
say_en.note: Claude will call Gemini to analyze and describe the image.
